highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 previews Skia m147 with variable fonts and the new SKPathBuilder API.
highlights_body: It also adds animated WebP encoding, color font palettes, surface sampling controls, and new Linux and Tizen assets. This preview raises the WebAssembly floor to .NET 8 and removes 32-bit Tizen assets, so review the migration notes before upgrading.

breaking.title: SKPath mutation moves to SKPathBuilder
breaking.body: SKPath mutation methods and SKPath destinations for fill-path and segment operations are now obsolete. Move path construction to SKPathBuilder and use its Detach or Snapshot methods; use the new SKPathBuilder overloads for SKPaint.GetFillPath and SKPathMeasure.GetSegment.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Update references to the correctly cased type; the obsolete GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo compatibility type no longer supplies its former IEquatable implementation or equality operators.

breaking.title: WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8
breaking.body: Native assets for Emscripten versions associated with .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed, and those targets now produce a build error. Upgrade Blazor WebAssembly or Uno Platform WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: 32-bit Tizen native assets removed
breaking.body: Tizen arm and x86 native builds no longer ship. Move supported Tizen deployments to the tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64 runtime identifiers.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move validates its 32-bit native range
breaking.body: SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and now throws OverflowException when the offset cannot fit the native 32-bit operation instead of silently truncating it. Use offsets within the Int32 range and migrate away from the long overload.

breaking.title: Assembly version moves to 4.x
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.147.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any hard-coded assembly-version checks.

bullets.lead: Skia advances from m119 through m147
bullets.detail: The bundled engine incorporates improved EXIF orientation, HDR and wide-gamut processing, color-aware filters, CICP color spaces, R16Unorm and additional HDR color types, and the upstream immutable-path model.

bullets.lead: Bundled image and font dependencies refreshed
bullets.detail: Updates libpng to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, FreeType to 2.14.3, and libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SKTypeface, SKFontArguments and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, design coordinates, named instances, palette selection and palette overrides; HBColor preserves HarfBuzz's BGRA representation and converts to SkiaSharp colors.

bullets.lead: SKPathBuilder becomes the path construction API
bullets.detail: The new builder wraps path mutation and adds builder destinations for fill paths and measured segments, while the engine update also exposes codec memory limits and XPS options.
New SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions so callers can select filtering when compositing surfaces.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP and direct stream data access
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder encodes frame sequences, while SKStream.GetData returns ref-counted SKData when a stream can expose its backing data directly.
Adds SKDocument.CreateXps options overloads, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, and SKMaskFilter.CreateShader, and standardizes the GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo type name.

Managed default-typeface resolution avoids Android startup crashes, variable-font Span methods handle undersized buffers correctly, and SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs no longer recurses until a StackOverflowException.
Reattaching an SKGLView after a MAUI TabBar switch or page navigation now starts its GL thread with the current dimensions instead of leaving a blank 0-by-0 surface.
The native stream move ABI now uses an explicit 32-bit offset, preventing negative values such as -1 from being zero-extended on 64-bit Unix platforms.
SKPath no longer flushes a builder after disposal begins, preventing a finalizer-thread crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first.
Windows NanoServer builds use an empty font manager when DirectWrite and GDI are unavailable, avoiding an AccessViolation during SKTypeface static initialization.
Native packages add linux-bionic binaries for x64 and arm64 plus tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 runtime assets.
Libraries use the base 26.0 target platform version so consumers are not forced onto Xcode 26.2, while apps use unversioned Apple TFMs.

contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and legacy-target build compatibility
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia m132 and m147 integration, variable fonts, default-typeface reliability, the SKPath finalizer fix, and Uno samples
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed Android SKGLView rendering after MAUI TabBar switches and navigation

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Introduces Skia m147 with the SKPathBuilder migration, HDR and CICP APIs, variable and color fonts, sampling controls, refreshed libpng and libexpat, and new Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets. It fixes font handling, SKStream offsets and Android SKGLView reattachment while removing 32-bit Tizen assets.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and direct SKStream data access, fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and realigns Apple library target frameworks.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Raises WebAssembly native assets to a .NET 8 floor, adds HBColor plus XPS, resource-flush and shader mask-filter APIs, and corrects Vulkan type casing. It fixes NanoServer initialization and refreshes libjpeg-turbo, FreeType and zlib.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, the HBColor value type, and native assets for Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen.
